finalText:
**Redis lost connection, and the outage cascaded until the process group died.**

At `2026-07-04T02:14:07Z` Redis dropped (`ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`). The app fell back to direct store reads, which couldn't keep up.

For the next 17 minutes, `worker-1`, `worker-2`, `scheduler`, and `api` all logged repeating `TimeoutError` after `5000ms`, steady cache miss storms, and a growing request queue, from 52 up to 568 against a max of 500. Redis reconnect attempts fired every ~80s and failed all 12 times.

At `2026-07-04T02:31:44Z` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` from the backlog and was restarted by the supervisor. Eight seconds later, `2026-07-04T02:31:52Z`, `api` went unresponsive and the supervisor killed the whole process group. See [logs/app.log:717](logs/app.log:717) through [logs/app.log:719](logs/app.log:719).

Root cause: Redis (`10.0.0.12:6379`) went unreachable and never came back, and nothing shed load while the queue climbed.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12` went down and add a circuit breaker so queue depth can't grow unbounded.
